metadata.title: Nvidia Stock Breaks Unwanted Record. How It Finally Sold the Growth Story.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Nvidia Stock Breaks Unwanted Record. How It Finally Sold the Growth Story.
It’s fifth time lucky for Nvidia. After a run of four quarterly earnings reports in which the stock slumped the following trading session, the chip maker finally appears to have hit on a winner by overturning assumptions about how fast it can grow.
